standard: PEC 2017 (Philippine Electrical Code Part 1), Table 2.40.1.6(A) Standard Ampere Ratings for Fuses and Inverse Time Circuit Breakers, printed pages 85-86; 2.40.1.4(B) and (C), printed pages 83-84
note: Transcribed from the printed pages. 2.40.1.4(B): the next higher standard rating above the ampacity of the conductors being protected is permitted where (1) the conductors are not part of a branch circuit supplying more than one receptacle for cord-and-plug-connected portable loads, (2) the ampacity does not correspond with the standard ampere rating of a fuse or a circuit breaker without overload trip adjustments above its rating, and (3) the next higher standard rating selected does not exceed 800 A. 2.40.1.4(C): above 800 A the ampacity shall be equal to or greater than the device rating. 2.40.1.6(A) adds 1, 3, 6, 10 and 601 A as standard ratings for fuses only; they are listed here but the next higher rating is taken from the table, which serves both fuses and breakers. The FPN allows other internationally accepted ratings, e.g. 16 A against 15 A and 32 A against 30 A.
